notes: This assigned page alone was read: the original once for layout, each supplied native half once token by token, then all fifteen saved crops once. No OCR, external research, recognition library or compilation was used.

The manuscript has page3 above and page116 at bottom left, with no date. The opening and the later On introduit paragraph continue the same main hand. H editorial comments and its drawing description are not source prose.

Agreements were checked as well as disagreements: every letter and index in the first relation and commutation identity, the numbers2/4 and reference(4), the complete tuple/source-target formulas(13), both boxed formulas(14), every caption word and insertion, and each regional drawing path and label are covered in the inventory and drawing audit.

The cancelled opening wording favors soit la but remains ambiguous against qui est la. All of -ci soit is interlinear. The separate cancellation condition is readable and the curved leader attaches dernière in its place. The points-to-sommets revision is likewise explicit.

The first cancelled mathematical cluster favors two factors tau0 tauinfinity, but the heavy strike leaves tau0 alone as an alternative. Its first reading is based on two top/index clusters, not on restoring the neighboring equation.

The ne joue plus phrase is directly legible in the role crop; H’s comment that it is demanded by the mathematics is not used as the evidence. The abbreviations op., p.r., resp. and i.e without a final dot remain unexpanded.

Formula(13) is preserved with three source anomalies: the first lambda subscript has tau_(i+1) but no r; the second begins with a closed sigma, not the open-hooked tau written elsewhere; and the final R superscript contains only i-1. A mathematically regularized version would normally use a repère argument, a tau involution and two type indices, but none is silently supplied.

The two connectors in(13) are reproduced by their actual horizontal shafts and short upward terminal ticks. The physical geometry is clear; whether these are rapid arrows or mere connectors is not decided. Thus M0593/M0595 use other with an exact graphic reading, while semantic doubt is retained here and below.

After(13), the caption has only a closing double quote after cran. The absent opening mark is not supplied to balance it. The base comma after(i,i+1) remains before its insertion; the insertion leader is not treated as an additional comma. The en sens opposé insertion attaches before the period after r.

No external drawing files for H were supplied or assessed. Its broad descriptions of arcs do not specify their local directions. Direction corrections are charged to C only; H’s concrete wrong indices, comma and omitted cancelled prefix/residue are treated locally.

Near the lower transformed R, zero is legible but subsequent overwork meets the dark endpoint. It is preserved as uncertain graphic residue, with possible index readings recorded rather than selected. The upper extra crosshatched cluster likewise remains a graphic remnant; no missing label is invented from geometry.

The upper endpoint of lambda_r^1 favors a narrow upward/right head. Both reader and main reader observed the cap/wing separately from the adjacent headless longer curve. Its physical thickening leaves some doubt, so the added head is marked uncertain in place. The long central infinity-to0 side remains single-headed downward because no reverse head is separately secure.

A small oblique mark at the lower edge of the first formula14 box is not identified as an additional formula sign or a punctuation mark; no mathematical token is inferred from it. The two enclosing boxes and all of their mathematical contents are retained.

Only the conditional algebraic checks explicitly recorded below were performed. They explain the expected regularization but do not prove that the literal incomplete/sigma-bearing line(13) is well-defined or authorize changing it.

check_events.statement: For involutions a,b, (ab)^2=1 if and only if ab=ba.
check_events.place: first displayed relation and the later ou encore commutation sentence
check_events.outcome: Passed conditionally on a²=b²=1: if (ab)²=1 then ab=(ab)^-1=b^-1a^-1=ba; conversely commuting involutions give (ab)²=a²b²=1. This checks the asserted equivalence under the involution convention, without importing any extra relation.

check_events.statement: If t²=1 and L_r=lambda_(t r)^-1 lambda_r, then L_r L_(t r)=1. Likewise if Lprime_r=lambda_(t r) lambda_r^-1, then Lprime_r Lprime_(t r)=1.
check_events.place: formula(14), compared conditionally with the intended fully indexed tau version of(13)
check_events.outcome: Passed as formal composable products: substitute t²r=r, giving lambda_(t r)^-1 lambda_r lambda_r^-1 lambda_(t r)=1, and lambda_(t r) lambda_r^-1 lambda_r lambda_(t r)^-1=1. The check is conditional and does not apply unqualifiedly to the source’s missing r and literal sigma.
